entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: A protocol data unit session that enables user data transmission with different QoS treatments based on session type.

entities.name: QoS flow
entities.description: A data flow with specific quality of service characteristics for user data packets.

entities.name: QoS rule
entities.description: A rule defining QoS treatment for user data packets, which can be signalled or derived.

entities.name: Unstructured PDU session type
entities.description: A PDU session type where all uplink user data packets are associated with the same QoS flow.

entities.name: Structured PDU session type
entities.description: PDU session types (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, Ethernet) that enable different QoS treatments for uplink user data packets.

relations.description: PDU session utilizes QoS flows for handling user data packets.
QoS flow treatment is determined by QoS rules (signalled, derived, or combination).
Unstructured PDU session type establishes that all uplink user data packets use the same QoS flow.
Structured PDU session types enable different QoS treatments across multiple QoS flows.
